current_bottleneck: The unified path family still needs a shared stochastic state, but 313 showed that an auxiliary latent bottleneck next to a direct path decoder is optional and therefore ignored. The next family has to make the latent state the actual sequential generative law for the future path, not a side code the decoder can bypass.
last_result_summary: Research ideation after 313a/313b concluded that continuing inside naive latent bottlenecks would only replay the old 267a/267b collapse. The useful lesson from 274a/274b was not to add KL tricks, but to place the latent state inside the time-evolution law itself so that direct path supervision and stochastic state usage coexist structurally.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 314a: a history-conditioned probabilistic token-state logit path model with q(z_t|x_t,h), p(z_t|z_{t-1},h), and p(x_t|z_t,h). Keep the decoder simple, keep the core vanilla, and kill the family quickly if KL collapses again or sampled width remains near zero.
